name: Autotest
description: Soft/hardware integration test rail: requirement decomposition, case generation, a human review gate, script authoring, execution, failure analysis and reporting.
author: PI Desktop

agentTools.name: autotest_requirement
agentTools.description: Stage 1 of the autotest workbench. Turn requirement text, a file path or a document reference into a feature breakdown with acceptance criteria and an explicit gap list. Creates a plan when planId is omitted.

source.description: Requirement text, or a path or reference to the material.

sourceRef.description: Original location of the material, for traceability.

planId.description: Reuse an existing plan instead of creating one.

agentTools.name: autotest_cases
agentTools.description: Stage 2. Generate test cases from the approved feature list. The result is presented for human review and nothing downstream may consume it before approval.

action.description: Regenerate discards the previous case set.

regenerate.description: Allow running even if the stage check would block.

agentTools.name: autotest_select
agentTools.description: Adjust which reviewed cases take part in the next run. Selection never approves a case; the gate still requires an explicit approval.

action.description: Select or deselect the listed cases.

testCaseIds.description: Test case ids such as TC-001.

selected.description: Explicit target state; omit to select the listed ids.

agentTools.name: autotest_author
agentTools.description: Stage 3. Write one runnable script per approved test case. Refuses to run while the case set is unapproved, so materialised code always traces back to a reviewed case.

testCaseIds.description: Optional subset of case ids to author in this call. Batch at most 3 per call — every script needs its own model call, and one tool call has a bounded budget.

agentTools.name: autotest_run
agentTools.description: Stage 4. Execute the approved scripts with a bounded timeout and captured output. Never runs before an approved case set exists.

testCaseIds.description: Run only these cases; omit to run every script.

maxOutput.description: Captured output retained per stream, in characters (default 4096).

agentTools.name: autotest_diagnose
agentTools.description: Stage 5. Classify the failures of the last run deterministically first (environment, script, assertion, product, flaky, unknown), then ask the model only for narrative. Reports blocking failures that a script rewrite must not paper over.

agentTools.name: autotest_report
agentTools.description: Stage 6. Render the plan into markdown with the stage rail, coverage, gate state, diagnosis and audit trail, and write report.md next to the plan state.

agentTools.name: autotest_status
agentTools.description: Read-only. Summarise one plan, or list every plan when planId is omitted: stage rail, coverage, review gate, last run and artifacts.

safetyNotes: Writes only inside its own plugin data directory. Executes scripts without a shell, passing an argument array, with a per-script timeout and a bounded output buffer. Scripts are written only after a recorded human approval, and failure analysis never rewrites a script or weakens an assertion. Runs no background service and opens no network listener.

zh-CN.name: 自动化测试
zh-CN.description: 软硬件集成测试链路：需求分解、用例生成、人工审核门、脚本生成、执行、失败分析与报告。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只写入本插件自己的数据目录。执行脚本不经过 shell，使用参数数组，带单脚本超时与输出上限。只有记录在案的人工批准之后才写脚本，失败分析绝不改写脚本、绝不降低断言强度。不常驻后台服务，不监听网络端口。
